prompt_data.main_prompt: Design a captivating T-shirt for DreamShaperXL Turbo featuring a minimalist tech aesthetic with clean typography and a circuit board pattern. The design should have geometric elements that create a modern and sleek look. Utilize a monochromatic color palette with accent colors to emphasize the clean lines of the typography and graphic components. Ensure the design is suitable for print-on-demand production, maintaining high resolution.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid overly complex designs that may appear blurred or pixelated on a T-shirt. Steer clear from poor quality indicators such as low-resolution graphics, illegible text, or unbalanced compositions.
